summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed a Form 6-K to announce the admission to trading of EUR 500 million 4.250% Notes due 2038 on the London Stock Exchange's Main Market, under its existing Euro Medium Term Note Programme. This is a routine debt issuance notification, not a special situation. The filing satisfies UK Prospectus Rules but does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change.
